description_full: TFA Therapeutics, Inc. develops TFA-01 novel nonsteroidal anti-inflammatory drugs for pet medical care. It offers drugs in the areas of canine osteoarthritis, dermatitis, and feline stomatitis. The company serves customers in Taiwan, Japan, Greater China, and United States. TFA Therapeutics, Inc. was formerly known as Cordyceps Sunshine Biotech Holdings Co., Ltd. and changed its name to TFA Therapeutics, Inc. in July 2026. The company was incorporated in 2020 and is based in Taipei, Taiwan.
